Question 10
?

Given that the differential equation d2ydx2+25y=−20cos⁡5x−10sin⁡5x has the complementary function yc(x)=Acos⁡5x+Bsin⁡5x, find the particular solution yp(x) to this equation.

a
yp=4xsin⁡5x
b
yp=−2xcos⁡5x+3xsin⁡5x
c
yp=3xcos⁡5x−xsin⁡5x
d
yp=xcos⁡5x−2xsin⁡5x
e
yp=−2xcos⁡5x
